name: Roam Free Hair Studio
summary: Roam Free Hair Studio is an independent hair salon in Georgetown, Texas, offering personalized styling services in a boutique setting. Open daily from 9 AM to 6 PM, this locally-owned business serves the community with quality hair care and modern customer engagement.
demographics: Roam Free Hair Studio serves the Georgetown, Texas market, which attracts a diverse demographic mix including young professionals, families, and retirees drawn to the area's blend of historic charm and modern growth. The primary customer base consists of middle to upper-middle income residents, with a strong representation of women aged 25-55 who value personalized beauty services and are willing to invest in quality hair care. Georgetown's position as one of the fastest-growing cities in Texas brings an influx of educated, style-conscious consumers who appreciate locally-owned businesses and maintain active social media engagement, aligning well with the salon's Instagram-focused marketing approach.
description: Roam Free Hair Studio is a boutique hair salon located at 900 North Austin Avenue in the heart of Georgetown, Texas. This independent beauty destination offers personalized hair care services in an intimate, welcoming environment that reflects the creative spirit of its stylists. Operating daily from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, the studio has built a loyal following through its commitment to quality service and individual attention to each client's unique style needs. The salon's presence on social media, particularly Instagram, showcases its modern approach to connecting with the Georgetown community and beyond. As a locally-owned business in this historic Texas city, Roam Free Hair Studio represents the kind of specialized, service-oriented tenant that adds character and convenience to neighborhood shopping areas.
